title: Vampire Vape Vlads VG Blue Gun 10ml
description: Blue Gun from Vampire Vape’s Vlads collection captures the deliciously carefree taste of juicy, sugary bubblegum candy and adds a smooth, sweet layer of fresh, delicately sour blueberry for a mouth-watering fusion of fruit and candy that will never leave your tank! Vampire Vapes’ new Vlads VG collection assembles some of the most iconic e-liquid flavours to come out of the legendary vape makers labs, and makes them available in high-VG, 10ml bottles. The collection includes such famous flavours as Heisenberg and Pinkman, as well as newer additions like Blue Gun, Loser and Attraction Fatal. Vampire Vapes’ Vlads VG e-liquids contain a 70VG/30PG ratio that makes them ideal for use in vape kits that use sub-ohm coils, as well as being easy to travel with. These kits include advanced vape kits as well as pod kits and refillable pods that use coils with a resistance of 0.8ohm or lower. Their High-VG content provides a deeply flavoursome experience with a smooth, comfortable throat hit and clouds of satisfying vaper! Based in Manchester, England Vampire Vape are one of the most popular and influential e-liquid brands in the UK. The company has won international renown for the quality and variety of their e-liquids, and for their signature flavours including such game-changing e-liquid icons as Heisenberg and Pinkman flavours.
